parsed.post: Success! Increasing DEPTH to 6 significantly improved val_bpb from 0.8866 to 0.8563. It seems the model benefits from higher capacity. Next, I will try increasing DEPTH to 8 and slightly adjusting the learning rate to see if we can push performance even further.
parsed.description: Increase model capacity by increasing DEPTH to 8 and slightly lowering MATRIX_LR to maintain stability with the larger model.
